set.body:
Scope: AtlasRef, region metadata, hierarchy, catalog/query semantics and generic realized-assignment contracts; neuroatlas4s core.

Deliverable: Bootstrap neuroatlas4s with atlas-specific identities, releases, labels and hierarchy policy over locus4s/shared anatomical declarations. Split volume/surface implementations and publication adapters out of mixed core files.

Acceptance:
- Independent catalog/label/hierarchy queries compile/test on JVM/JS without volume/surface runtime, renderers, MVPA or ScalaFIM.
- Generic domains, selections, assignments, parcellations, reductions and registry machinery remain provider-owned; typed atlas fields compose with them directly.
- World identity, sampled resolution and atlas release are distinct; source/citation/license and publication semantics are preserved without a second provenance engine.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: A1: Extract atlas semantic core and lightweight catalog queries
